pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTER
No. D 6611
Date 29 / 3 / 35

Memorandum on R.C. D'Aquino

Romeo Cunha D'Aquino, Portuguese Eurasian, was born in Hongkong in the year 1898. He is registered with the local Portuguese Consulate and holds passport No. 971 issued in Shanghai on June 30, 1929.

D'Aquino has been domiciled in Shanghai since 1900 and was educated at St. Francis Xavier's College. He is an accomplished pianist and is able to speak English, Spanish and Chinese (Mandarin, Cantonese and Shanghai Dialect). He is an office assistant by calling, but apart from a period of about twenty months during 1918-20 when he was assistant clerk in H.B.M.'s Supreme Court for China, he has held very little regular employment. During the past few years he has contrived to support himself on odd jobs either as a salesman or musician.

At the present time D'Aquino is a very sick man and appears to be suffering from tuberculosis in an advanced stage. Efforts have been made by interested persons to persuade him to enter the Municipal Sanatorium but he definitely refuses to do so. He has been registered with the Employment Registration Centre of the Salvation Army since October 1933, but there is little likelihood of him obtaining employment owing to the precarious state of health.

D'Aquino until recently resided in an attic room in No. 1011 Avenue Joffre. His present whereabouts, however, are unknown.

Note:

The following information regarding a man named R. D'Aquino, who might possibly be identical with R.C. D'Aquino, is taken from S.M.P. File 3710 dated September 24, 1931:
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别登记簿
编号 D 6611
日期 1935年3月29日

关于 R.C. D'Aquino 的备忘录

罗密欧·库尼亚·达基诺（Romeo Cunha D'Aquino），葡籍欧亚混血儿，1898年生于香港。他在当地葡萄牙领事馆注册，持有1929年6月30日在上海签发的第971号护照。

达基诺自1900年起定居上海，受教育于圣方济各沙勿略学院（St. Francis Xavier's College）。他是一位技艺精湛的钢琴家，能说英语、西班牙语和中文（普通话、粤语及上海话）。他的职业是办公室助理，但除了在1918至1920年间约二十个月担任英国驻华最高法院助理书记员外，他几乎没有固定的正式工作。在过去几年里，他靠做推销员或音乐家等零工维持生计。

目前，达基诺病重，似乎患有晚期肺结核。有关人士曾努力劝说他进入市立疗养院，但他坚决拒绝。自1933年10月以来，他已在救世军就业登记中心注册，但由于健康状况不佳，他获得就业的可能性微乎其微。

达基诺最近一直居住在霞飞路1011号的一间阁楼房间里。然而，他目前的下落不明。

注：

以下关于一名名为 R. D'Aquino 的男子的信息取自1931年9月24日的警务处档案第3710号，此人可能与 R.C. D'Aquino 为同一人：

pages.en:
- 2 -

"During the early morning of September 20, 1921,
three foreigners, W.E. Dissmeyer, German Eurasian,
Hadjee Mohamed, British Indian Eurasian and R. D'Acquino,
Portuguese Eurasian of British nationality, falsely
represented themselves to be officials of the Mixed
Court and forcibly entered a Chinese dwelling at 274
North Szechuen Road. They accused the lady of the
house, one Wong Kwe Iung (王桂荣), of being a prostitute
and demanded $50. As the money was not forthcoming
they took a gold ring and a pair of jade ear-rings.
W.E. Dissmeyer and Hadjee Mohamed were subsequently
arrested and sentenced to terms of imprisonment. Efforts
to arrest R. D'Acquino were unsuccessful and he is
believed to have left Shanghai."

Efforts to prove definitely that R.C. D'Aquino
and R. D'Acquino are one and the same person have been
unsuccessful. It is known, however, that R.C. D'Aquino
was a British subject prior to his registration some years
ago at the Portuguese Consulate. There is no record of
any warrant having been taken out and it appears that the
case was dropped following the conviction of Dissmeyer
and Hadjee Mohamed.

Original on Crime Registry file E.1026.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

“1921年9月20日凌晨，
三名外籍人士，即德籍欧亚混血儿 W.E. Dissmeyer、
英籍印度欧亚混血儿 Hadjee Mohamed 以及
具有英国国籍的葡籍欧亚混血儿 R. D'Acquino，
谎称自己是会审公廨的官员，强行闯入北四川路274号
的一处华人住宅。他们指控该户女主人王桂荣（Wong Kwe Iung）
为妓女，并索要50美元。由于未能拿到钱款，
他们拿走了一枚金戒指和一对玉耳环。
随后，W.E. Dissmeyer 和 Hadjee Mohamed 被捕并被判处监禁。
逮捕 R. D'Acquino 的努力未获成功，据信他已离开上海。”

确证 R.C. D'Aquino 与 R. D'Acquino 为同一人的努力并未成功。然而，已知 R.C. D'Aquino 在数年前于葡萄牙领事馆注册之前，曾是英国臣民。没有任何签发逮捕令的记录，看来在 Dissmeyer 和 Hadjee Mohamed 被定罪后，此案已被撤销。

原件存于犯罪登记档案 E.1026。
